correctness.rationale: The incidence graph definition gives 20 vertices, degree 3 and 30 edges. An independent exhaustive subset enumeration gives 62,048 nonempty Ind_2 faces, f-vector (20,190,1080,3985,9784,15910,16600,10390,3460,564,60,5). A fresh augmented sequential coordinate-toggle matching has 31,004 pairs, 41 critical cardinality-8 faces and full oriented Hasse DAG acyclic on 62,049 vertices. After unmatching the empty-face pair, one critical 0-cell and 41 critical 7-cells establish an integral wedge of 41 seven-spheres by discrete Morse theory, not by homology alone. An independent signed fixed-face Lefschetz enumeration across all fourteen S5×C2 conjugacy classes exactly reproduced the listed H7 traces: (1,1,1,-1,1,1,41) without layer complement and (1,1,-1,1,1,5,1) with it. The inspected source character-table orthogonality/inner products then give the stated nine irreducibles with dimension sum 41, central parts 21+20 and one invariant line. The graph symmetry proof identifies Aut(D)=S5×C2. Rational quotient homology follows from finite-group invariants after equivariant subdivision, with no claim about quotient homotopy.
